translations.web: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
translations.bsb: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
translations.kjv: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
translations.asv: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaketh.
